_meta.purpose: Event emitted by identity µservice when a new principal is committed to the tenancy substrate during j21 signup.
industry_citations: Apple WebAuthn UV-required platform-attached authenticator pattern
Signal X3DH initial registration (Open Whisper Systems 2018)

event_class.description: Audit-event class per ADR-0263 registry. MUST match the central registry exactly.

event_id.description: Unique event id; UUIDv7 for HLC-compatible ordering.

tenant_id.description: Per ADR-0242 + ADR-0244 tenant model; for j21 always 'oyatie.b2c.personal'.

principal_class.description: Class taxonomy per ADR-0242; for j21 always 'human'.

audience_type.description: Per ADR-0244 audience taxonomy; for j21 b2c_personal_consumer.

home_cell.description: Cell-pin per ADR-0248; for j21 typically ap-seoul-1.

shard_id.description: Per ADR-0248 §D-3 deterministic shard from hash(principal_id) % 16.

compliance_packs.description: Active compliance packs at creation time; per ADR-0251.

provider_credential_mode.description: Per ADR-0255 §D-4 provider-BYOK mode; for j21 default.

created_at_hlc.description: HLC timestamp per ADR-0252; format: epoch.logical.cell.shard.

signing_key_kid.description: Per-µservice sidecar signing key id per ADR-0296.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over canonical CBOR of all preceding fields.

kosa_tier_active.description: Per ADR-0292: true only if principal is 14-17; false for adult signups (j21).

minor_protection_mode.description: Per ADR-0292; null for adult j21 signups.
